title: Flipped output after one step
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a Boolean choice, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. Taking one step under $b$ with the machine whose output symbols are flipped, starting from the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit of $c$, gives the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit of the result of taking one step under $b$ with $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with Boolean symbols and k work tapes
